notes.title: RedDeer.Games and Turbo Napalm Join Forces: Nuclear Gladiators 3000
notes.notes:
Hey gladiators,

RedDeer.Games is thrilled to team up with Turbo Napalm to bring Nuclear Gladiators 3000, a brutal, retro-inspired roguelite action game to Steam!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711732/aee1cb68bf922bac79faaba74c57fd9d9e4a3951.png[/img]

Step into the radioactive arenas of the Blaster Vision Channel, where fame, carnage, and chaos collide! Fight hordes of mutants and outcasts in procedurally generated arenas, upgrade your gear, and entertain the crowd—or die trying.

Featuring fast-paced rogue-lite gameplay, unique warriors to choose from, and a killer 80s-style vibe, Nuclear Gladiators 3000 is an explosive ride through a dystopian future.

The game is now available for wishlisting on Steam, and the release is coming soon!
Stay tuned!

notes.title: DEMO RELEASE FOR NUCLEAR GLADIATORS 3000!
notes.notes:
We are very happy to announce the demo for our upcoming game! We hope you like it!
If so, please remember to [b]wishlist the game (this helps us A LOT)[/b]

You can also leave us feedback on Discord, the game forums or other ways.
We will read all your comments and try to respond to everyone.
Don't be shy to comment!

DEMO FEATURES:
- Play the first two chapters of the first scenario
- Two playable characters
- Twitch chat integration
- Demo progress will be carried over into the final game
